title: Structural and Binding Properties of Dps – A Nucleoid Associated Protein
authors: Matty Gaines; Daniel Parrell; Kaylee Jo Rajek; Steven Garvis; Bryan Sibert; Elizabeth R. Wright
one_liner_zh: 该文结合冷冻电镜、静电建模与EMSA研究细菌Dps蛋白与DNA的非特异性结合及pH调控组装机制，属于广义蛋白-DNA互作的结构与机制研究，方法可迁移至TF-DNA体系。
abstract: Prokaryotic chromosomal DNA is compacted and protected by nucleoid-associated proteins (NAPs). Among these, the DNA-binding proteins from starved cells (Dps) combine ferroxidase activity with nonspecific DNA binding to form dodecameric assemblies that condense and safeguard the genome under stress. Here, we present an integrated structural and biophysical analysis of Escherichia coli ( E. coli ) Dps across a pH range from 3 to 11, combining (i) single-particle cryo-EM reconstructions at ∼1.75 Å resolution, (ii) adaptive Poisson-Boltzmann electrostatic modelling, (iii) electrophoretic mobility shift assays (EMSAs) on a 448 bp DNA fragment, and (iv) cryo-electron tomography (cryo-ET) of Dps-DNA assemblies. Through this analysis, we show that (1) the canonical ferritin-like fold is maintained at all pH values; (2) surface electrostatics shift from highly positive to net negative as the pH increases, modulating DNA affinity ( EC 50 values of 73.4 nM at the lowest measurement of pH 5, to 815.5 nM at the highest measurement of pH 11); and (3) short-fragment Dps-DNA complexes form amorphous ∼50 nm globular or tubular complexes rather than lattice co-crystals observed on kilobase-length DNA scaffolds. The findings reveal a possible two-stage assembly model, in which protonation-driven nucleation occurs via the Dps N-terminal lysine residues, followed by lattice ordering on long DNA. Our results further define Dps as a pH-responsive nucleoid compaction factor in bacteria.
abstract_zh: 原核生物染色体DNA通过类核相关蛋白（nucleoid-associated proteins, NAPs）进行压缩和保护。其中，来自饥饿细胞的DNA结合蛋白（Dps）结合了铁氧化酶活性与非特异性DNA结合，形成十二聚体组装体，在应激条件下压缩并保护基因组。在此，我们展示了对大肠杆菌（Escherichia coli, E. coli）Dps在pH 3至11范围内的整合结构与生物物理分析，结合了（i）约1.75 Å分辨率的单颗粒冷冻电镜重建，（ii）自适应泊松-玻尔兹曼静电建模，（iii）对448 bp DNA片段的电泳迁移率变动分析（electrophoretic mobility shift assays, EMSAs），以及（iv）Dps-DNA组装的冷冻电子断层扫描（cryo-electron tomography, cryo-ET）。通过这一分析，我们表明：（1）典型的铁蛋白样折叠在所有pH值下均得以维持；（2）随着pH升高，表面静电从高度正电转变为净负电，从而调节DNA亲和力（EC 50 值从最低测量pH 5时的73.4 nM，到最高测量pH 11时的815.5 nM）；（3）短片段Dps-DNA复合物形成无定形的约50 nm球状或管状复合物，而非在千碱基长度DNA支架上观察到的晶格共晶。这些发现揭示了一种可能的两阶段组装模型，其中质子化驱动的成核通过Dps N端赖氨酸残基发生，随后在长DNA上进行晶格有序化。我们的结果进一步将Dps定义为细菌中pH响应的类核压缩因子。
